text: Confirmed and filed #6594: COPY TO TYPE CSV strips leading spaces from character values. VFP9 COM exports NOTE="  X" as "  X"; Copperfin stored the spaces (ASC(LEFT(NOTE,1))=32) but wrote "X". The current formatter trim_copy()s the raw value before quoting. Distinct from #6592 import-side whitespace loss. Issue verified OPEN and owner-authored, labeled bug/runtime/agent-approved; no production changes.
